title: gouldia ovata var. santalifolia

This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Gouldia ovata var. santalifolia are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent, as well as its potential to stimulate appetite and improve respiratory function.
